title: review
description: A review of another profile, at the path `review/<id>` in the reviewer's own profile. Only who it is about is required: a review can be as thin as pointing at a person. What is missing weighs less; nothing is refused. Its market is the market of the profile it is about, and that market may add fields.

subject.description: The reviewed profile's name: its address.

media.description: Optional. Photos and short videos of the work.

dealId.description: The deal this review is about: its escrow receipt's address (base58 of 32 bytes) when it went through the escrow, else 32 random bytes as lowercase hex, chosen when the deal began. Two reviews across one deal id show both sides took part. Optional; an index weighs a review without one, or without evidence under it, near zero.

rating.description: From "1" to "10", with at most one decimal ("8.5"): decimal text, since a record holds no fractional numbers.

ratings.description: Optional. Ratings by name. Any name may be used; overall by convention, and a market file suggests others.

media.description: A photo or a short video, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

size.description: Bytes. How large a blob to take is each host's policy, and each reader's.
